title: Скрипты, часть 1

requirements.title: Создание и назначение скрипта
details: Assets/Scripts/HelloWorldScript.cs; class HelloWorldScript : MonoBehaviour.
Start prints exactly Hello World; attach component to Main Camera.
Before attaching script nothing runs; retain a short explanation or separate inactive example instead of fake output.
checks: Enter Play: exactly one Hello World per camera component; verify component exists in Inspector; stop and rerun.

requirements.title: Использование встроенных методов
details: ImportantFunctions.cs on Main Camera.
Start prints Start runs before an object Updates.
Update prints This is called once a frame. Must demonstrate frame callback; do not replace with unrelated GUI label.
checks: Run briefly: initial Start line before repeated Update lines; stop quickly to avoid excessive logs.

requirements.title: Операторы
details: Book explicitly recommends EqualityAndOperations.cs from original Hour7 files; preserve original file and inspect examples.
Examples should cover arithmetic, assignment, comparison, logical conditions; explanatory examples are not separate required games.
checks: Open script and identify operator cases; actual output must match cases if attached.

requirements.title: Три отдельные задачи
details: Three separate scripts, all attached to Main Camera.
Task1 sums even integers 2 through499 inclusive and logs result62250.
Task2 visits all integers1..100; for multiples of3 OR5 prints Программирование — это прекрасно!, otherwise number.
checks: Console shows sum62250 once; task2 emits100 entries including47 replacements and53 numeric entries; Fibonacci task emits20 terms with final4181.

texture_mapping: This chapter does not require texture mapping or textured scenery; focus is C# and Console.
prior_scaffold_defects: Only final exercise was provided previously; HelloWorldScript, ImportantFunctions and EqualityAndOperations examples were omitted.

title: Скрипты, часть 2

requirements.title: Идентификация частей метода
details: Analyze int TakeDamage(int damageAmount) { int health=100; return health-damageAmount; }.
Answers: name TakeDamage, return int, one int parameter damageAmount, block declares health and returns subtraction.
checks: Keep answers in a short document; no invented 3D requirement.

requirements.title: Вызов перегруженных методов
details: FireBallScript.cs attached to Main Camera.
Implement int TakeDamageFromFireball() returning100-5; overload(int damage) returning100-damage; overload(int damage,int playerHealth) returning playerHealth-damage.
Start calls all three with(),(25),(30,50), logs Player health:95,75,20 respectively.
checks: Play emits health95,75,20 in order; all overloads present as class methods.

requirements.title: Считывание осей игрока
details: PlayerInput.cs attached to Main Camera; read Input.GetAxis("Horizontal") and("Vertical") in Update.
Log Horizontal movement selected: hVal / Vertical movement selected: vVal only when nonzero.
Default mappings include arrows and WASD; retain InputManager axes so remapping remains possible.
checks: Arrows and WASD yield positive/negative values; releasing returns zero; inspect Edit Project Settings Input.

requirements.title: Считывание определённых клавиш
details: PlayerInput variant on Main Camera: Input.GetKey(KeyCode.M) logs while held; Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.O) logs once per press.
checks: Hold M several frames vs hold O; verify different Console counts.

requirements.title: Считывание движения мыши
details: PlayerInput variant reads Mouse X and Mouse Y every Update; logs nonzero values for each axis.
checks: Move mouse horizontally/vertically with Game focus; corresponding signed values appear.

requirements.title: Преобразование локального объекта
details: Cube at(0,-1,0); CubeScript.cs attached to Cube.
Update: transform.Translate(.05f,0f,0f); transform.Rotate(0f,0f,1f); transform.localScale=new Vector3(1.5f,1.5f,1.5f).
This intentionally demonstrates cumulative per-frame local-space motion; retain book example separately from deltaTime-based controller.
checks: Cube follows a broad circle due to rotating local axes; scale stays1.5 rather than accumulating.

requirements.title: Преобразование целевого объекта
details: Cube at(0,-1,0); TargetCubeScript.cs attached to Main Camera.
Start target=GameObject.Find("Cube"); Update performs same Translate(.05,0,0),Rotate(0,0,1),localScale1.5 on target.
checks: Only camera has controlling script; cube still follows circular path; verify target found and no null references.

requirements.title: Управление кубом
details: Cube at(0,0,-5); CubeControlScript.cs in Scripts attached to cube.
Left/right moves along worldX negative/positive; down/up moves along worldZ negative/positive.
MouseY rotates CAMERA aboutX; MouseX rotates CUBE aboutY.
M toggles cube between original scale and double original scale.
checks: Check all four arrows both before and after mouse rotation; motion must remain intended axes; two M presses restore original size; camera pitch and cube yaw change independently.

texture_mapping: No textured model is required in this chapter; appropriate input mappings are required.
prior_scaffold_defects: Prior project only implements final CubeControlScript; six runtime practica and written method analysis omitted.

title: Столкновения

requirements.title: Использование твёрдых тел
details: Cube at(0,1,-5); first observe without Rigidbody, then add Rigidbody and observe gravity.
Explore Drag and Constraints; preserve baseline and gravity variant or explain change in scene notes.
checks: Without Rigidbody stays in place; with gravity falls; Inspector contains correct3D Rigidbody.

requirements.title: Эксперименты с коллайдерами
details: UpperCube at(0,1,-5) with Rigidbody.
LowerCube at(0,-1,-5),scale(4,.1,4),rot(0,0,15),Rigidbody useGravityfalse.
Observe two unrestrained bodies; then freeze ALL lowerCube position/rotation axes.
Final demonstrated variant removes upper BoxCollider, adds SphereCollider; lower rotation changed to(0,0,350).
Optional variant freeze only lower positionY and leave rest free.
checks: Before constraints both move; after FreezeAll lower fixed; upper cube with SphereCollider rolls like sphere.

requirements.title: Физические материалы
details: Import Characters/PhysicsMaterials original assets: Bouncy,Ice,Metal,Rubber,Tree, or create PhysicsMaterial assets matching investigated behavior.
Demonstrate Dynamic/StaticFriction,Bounciness,FrictionCombine,BounceCombine on Collider materials; do not confuse renderer Material with PhysicMaterial.
checks: Collider.sharedMaterial assigned; behavior differs under friction and bounce settings.

requirements.title: Работа с триггером
details: Cube BoxCollider.isTrigger=true with TriggerScript; sphere Rigidbody gravityfalse with MovementScript.
MovementScript.Update translates MouseX/10,MouseY/10,0.
TriggerScript logs enter,stay,exit with other.gameObject.name; callbacks declared at class level.
checks: Sphere responds to mouse; passes through cube without physical collision; logs all3 callback types.

requirements.title: Рейкастинг
details: RaycastScript.cs on Main Camera; Update reads MouseX,MouseY,rotates camera and calls CheckForRaycastHit().
Method uses Physics.Raycast(transform.position,transform.forward,out hit); logs hit object name, destroys hit.gameObject.
No shooting mouse-click requirement in printed practicum; hit is checked every frame.
checks: Aim camera centre at sphere: matching sphere destroyed and logged; RaycastHit type is correct.

requirements.title: Два триггера и управляемая сфера
details: LTrigger cube(-1.5,0,-5),scale(.1,2,2); RTrigger duplicate at(1.5,0,-5).
Sphere(0,0,-5),Rigidbody useGravityfalse; MotionScript on sphere.
TriggerScript on both cubes, BoxCollider.isTrigger=true (the omitted step is the exercise trick).
Arrow movement; log TRIGGER name plus entry/stay/exit type.
checks: Pass through both trigger planes using arrows; Console identifies LTrigger vs RTrigger and all events; no physical blocking.

texture_mapping: Physical materials mandatory for investigated examples; texture mapping not specifically required.
prior_scaffold_defects: Prior scaffold final trigger scene approximately matches end exercise, but omits gravity/collider/physical-material/mouse-trigger/raycast practica.

title: Игра вторая: Шар хаоса

requirements.title: Замкнутая арена
details: New project Шар хаоса; import Environment and Characters; save Scenes/Main.unity.
Plane origin scale(5,1,5) =>50×50 floor. Delete default Main Camera.
Material Wall Standard with Sand Albedo on Albedo; Smoothness0; TilingX10; assign to all four walls.
Water4Advanced from Standard Assets/Environment/Water/Water4/Prefabs at(0,.5,0).
SuperBouncy PhysicMaterial from fig10.3; assign PhysicsManager Default Material or explicitly to every colliding surface/body to preserve effect.
Fig10.3 visually confirmed: SuperBouncy dynamicFriction0,staticFriction0,bounciness1,frictionCombine Average,bounceCombine Maximum.
checks: Arena closed: balls cannot leave; wall texture visibly repeats10 times; floor water reflects as asset permits; spheres keep moving after bounces.

requirements.title: Контроллер и бампер
details: FPSController prefab at(0,1,0); FirstPersonCharacter camera child localPosition(0,5,-3.5),rotation(43,0,0).
Cube named Bumber (book typo),scale(3.5,3,1),parent FPSController; localPosition(0,0,1),localRotation0.
Material BumperColor with chosen Albedo color; FPSController movement configuration from fig10.5.

Fig10.5 visually confirmed: IsWalkingfalse,WalkSpeed5,RunSpeed20,RunstepLengthen.7,JumpSpeed0,StickToGroundForce10,GravityMultiplier2; MouseLook Xsensitivity3,Ysensitivity2,ClampVerticalRotationtrue,MinimumX0,MaximumX60,Smoothfalse,SmoothTime5,LockCursortrue; UseFovKicktrue,UseHeadBobfalse,StepInterval5,FootstepSounds Size0.

requirements.title: Шары хаоса и цветные шары
details: First Chaos sphere(12,2,12),scale(.5,.5,.5),yellow ChaosBall material,tag Chaos.
Rigidbody gravityfalse,CollisionDetection ContinuousDynamic,FreezePositionY.
VelocityScript startSpeed50; Start rigidbody.velocity=new Vector3(startSpeed,0,startSpeed).
Five Chaos spheres total (original plus4 duplicates),all y2; group Chaos Balls at origin.
Blue Ball,Red Ball,Orange Ball,Green Ball: each y2,default sphere scale1,matching colored materials BlueBall/Redball/GreenBall/OrangeBall and tags Blue/Red/Green/Orange.
Colored ball Rigidbody same gravity/collision/Y constraints; VelocityScript startSpeed25.
checks: Five fast yellow plus four slower colored balls move within arena; color/name/tag correctly match; no ball changesY.

requirements.title: Четыре угловые цели
details: Blue Goal empty(-22,2,-22),tagBlue; BoxCollider size(3,2,3),isTriggertrue; PointLight Blue intensity3 indirectMultiplier0.
Other goals tags/colors Red,Green,Orange at other corners(22,2,-22),(22,2,22),(-22,2,22); group Goals.
GoalScript has bool isSolved; OnTriggerEnter compares collided tag to own, marks solved,disables Light,destroys correct colored ball.
Game Manager with GameManager refs blue/green/red/orange GoalScript; gameover only when all4 isSolved; display Game Over.
Base book rules: player cannot lose. Do not add defeat by falling as substitute for objective.
checks: Wrong-colored sphere does not solve goal; matching ball solves exactly corresponding goal/light; victory only after all4 solved.

requirements.title: Модификация игры

Keep Main faithful to base chapter; separate Exercise scene may add restart/timer without replacing objective.
